blurb: DRIFT Yoga + Juice Bar offers yoga classes ranging from 45 to 90 minutes, including Vinyasa, Hatha, Slow Flow, Yoga for Athletes, Conditioning to Fly, Happy Hour Friday, and Yoga Nidra. The studio provides a reserve-only mat system with Manduka mats and props included. Workshops and special events explore deeper yoga practices and community experiences.
